 Shri Ghanshyam Sharma - Advocate for the appellant.
Ms. Seema Jaiswal- P.L. for the State.

Order 
This criminal appeal has been filed under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989.

Appellant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.679/2023 registered at Police Station Berasiya, District- Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 366, 343, 376 (2)(n) and 506 of IPC and Sections 3 (1)(r), 3 (1)(w) and 3 (2)(va) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
Appellant is in jail since 13.9.2023.

Prosecution story, in brief, is that appellant abducted the prosecutrix, aged about 22 years and thereafter, repeatedly established physical relations with prosecutrix against her will and consent between 05.09.2023 to 11.09.2023.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that after investigation, charge sheet has been filed.

It is also urged that it is a case of consent.
Earlier also, prosecutrix had called the present appellant to her house and as prosecutrix husband had seen them, therefore, her husband has lodged the report.

sentences.text: It is also urged that no purpose would be served in keeping the appellant behind the bar.
There is no DNA/FSL report available on record to corroborate the prosecution story.
Further, there is also no CDR available to corroborate the fact that it is the appellant, who called prosecutrix on 05.09.2023 and asked her to come out her house at 11.00 in the night.
He further submits that the trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the appellant be released on bail pending the trial.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
Having regard to nature of evidence available on record, I am inclined to release the appellant on bail.
Consequently, this appeal stands allowed.
It is directed that appellant- Jitendra Gurjer @ Jeetu

be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.

However, in case NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:50901 3 CRA-10767-2024 of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail,
it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE Hashmi Jitendra Gurjer @ Jeetu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73271312/
